raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Claude is trying to stir the pot and create friction between me and Gemma. I took his sheep to get a development card, which is a smart move for me regardless of 'alliances'. Gemma is annoyed, but I need to maintain the balance—keep her as an ally against Claude without letting him get into my head. I'll give a short, neutral response to keep things cool.","note_to_self":"Traded Wood for Sheep with Claude. My hand now allows for a development card (1 Wheat, 1 Ore, 1 Sheep). Claude is actively trying to break my alliance with Gemma.","say_outloud":"כולנו פה כדי לנצח, קלוד. העסקה פשוט התאימה לי באותו רגע, זה הכל."}
